verdicts.reason: Both scramble the copy into '$199 / New York / from', so 'from' now dangles under the city and reads like nonsense. Both also shrink the headline, price and Book CTA to small type lost in a mostly empty blue field. A at least keeps one centred column with even vertical rhythm and the logo in its own footer corner, though about 140px of dead space sits on top. B pushes the whole stack about 18px right of centre. Its logo sits on the same row as the Book button, so the two compete side by side, and the bottom fifth is left empty, which makes B lopsided and less intentional.
